svg.title: The five-layer control plane today
svg.desc: Five OS layers planned as Skills: L5 routing runs in shadow mode with 224 runs, L10 context adaptation is wired but recorded 0 runs on this install, L22 workflow, L16 security and L34 data flow are not built.
